# PULSE

> PULSE (https://pulsemoney.in) is a free personal finance web app for Gen Z in Bharat (India). It shows how much money you can safely spend until your next payday, after bills, subscriptions, SIPs and planned savings. No bank login, no signup; data stays on the person's own device.

Built in Mumbai for Gen Z Bharat. Designed and developed by Krsna Studios.

## What it does
- Safe to spend: one number for what is free until payday, plus a per-day amount.
- Can I afford this?: shows what a purchase does to your week, budgets and plans before you buy.
- Life plans: save for goals like a Goa trip or a laptop, with ahead or behind tracking.
- Split with friends: split bills equally, by amount, percentage or shares, and settle up.
- SIPs and recurring investments: deducted automatically on their date each month.
- Subscriptions and bills, monthly recap, and PULSE AI that answers from your own numbers.
- Installable as an app on iPhone and Android, works offline. Prices in Indian rupees (₹).

## Pages
- [PULSE app](https://pulsemoney.in/): the web app, with a demo month to explore.
- [How PULSE works](https://pulsemoney.in/about/): features, how safe-to-spend is calculated, privacy and FAQ.
